Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd, the operator of Domino’s Pizza in India and several international markets, reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 26,087 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, registering an 11.9 percent year-on-year increase. According to the company’s provisional business update filed with the BSE and NSE, standalone revenue from operations grew 11.6 percent year-on-year to Rs 18,858 million during the second quarter of FY27. [...] > “Standalone Revenue from operations for the quarter ended (QE) September 30, 2026, stood at Rs 19,206.18 crore,” the company said in its quarterly update.

D-Mart's standalone revenue also increased 4.7 percent compared with the preceding quarter. Avenue Supermarts reported revenue of Rs 18,343.49 crore for the April-June quarter of FY27. The latest figures indicate continued growth in the retailer's revenue as it operates across multiple markets in India's organised retail sector. [...] Westlife Foodworld Limited, which operates McDonald's restaurants across West and South India through its wholly owned subsidiary Hardcastle Restaurants Pvt Ltd, reported a 16 percent year-on-year increase in revenue from operations to Rs 7.47 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Same-store sales growth (SSSG) reached 10.1 percent, supported by double-digit growth in customer visits.
